name: Return to Denalan
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. narrative.details:
I have just received word that  Denalan at Lake Al'Ameth has discovered what may be the cause of the tumors that plague the timberlings. Please speak with him, and tell him I sent you.

Make haste, adventurer; he needs our help.
narrative.objectives: Rellian Greenspyre wants you to speak with Denalan at Lake Al'Ameth.
narrative.offerRewardText:
Ah, so Rellian sent you to aid me. I am glad you arrived here so soon.

I have discovered something quite disturbing!
